approval_source.question_set: Whether 4 GB staging hosts are accepted against the hosting approval's 8 GB per role (P01_E05_HOSTING_2026-10-11, D12-Q01) (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: The draft for this decision (after the 10 November startup failure) took the hosting record's 8 GB per role as the mainnet rule. P01_E05_TWO_SEATS_2026-10-11 replaced it: the two seats run on the founder's two 4 GB servers with the node's memory limit at 3 GiB, 'measure first, resize if needed', measured by T05. The staging hosts are those servers, so their T05 is the measurement TWO_SEATS asks for.

decisions.question: Staging host memory
decisions.selected: Keep the 4 GB servers and the 3 GiB node limit under P01_E05_TWO_SEATS_2026-10-11; T05 on them is the mainnet sizing measurement
decisions.rule: The 8 GB rule of P01_E05_HOSTING_2026-10-11 stays superseded by P01_E05_TWO_SEATS_2026-10-11. If T05 or the startup timings show the 4 GB servers or the 3 GiB limit fall short, resizing goes to a new decision. Shared vCPU stays a disclosed difference from a dedicated-vCPU validator.

does_not_authorize: Resizing, rebuilding or contacting any host
